description:
§42.4 / §63.5 — the canonical twin of condition/given-presence-deprecated-markup: the markup guard written as the `scrml fix` given-presence rewrite, `${ if (@user is given) {

${@user.name}

} }`. It renders "ada" while @user is present and re-renders the FRESH value when the present value changes (click #go: "ada" → "bob", @user stays present) — the SAME DOM and state as the deprecated form, with no W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED. The pair is the §63.5 runtime-identity assertion for the markup form.
rationale:
§42.2.3 (S462) canonical replacement table: "`${ given @u :> {

…

} }` | `${ if (@u is given) {

…

} }`" — "Each canonical form narrows what the deprecated form narrows". §7.4.2: "When `expr` references one or more reactive cells (`@x` access), the interpolation site SHALL re-render whenever any referenced cell changes". Before #1397 the `if` form kept the stale "ada" (g-impl1-markup-if-branch-memo-stale-render-s462, resolved). Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go".
